```{r Load libs, install from BiocManager or github}

library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(sctransform)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(remotes)
library(reticulate)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(DoubletFinder)

```

```{r Example of individual sample data pre-processing and QC}

# Load the Read10X data generated by alignment from cellranger outs/ raw_feature_bc_matrix/ folder

nuclei.data <- Read10X(data.dir = "Alignment/SAMPLE_1/filtered_feature_bc_matrix")
nuclei <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = nuclei.data, project = "nuclei_1", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

nuclei[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(nuclei, pattern = "^mt-")
VlnPlot(nuclei, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3, pt.size = 0)
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(nuclei, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(nuclei, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
plot1 + plot2

nuclei <- subset(nuclei, subset = nFeature_RNA > 500 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 10)

nuclei <- SCTransform(nuclei)
nuclei <- RunPCA(nuclei, verbose = FALSE)

pcs <-cumsum(nuclei@reductions$pca@stdev/sum(nuclei@reductions$pca@stdev))*100 
nuclei <- RunUMAP(nuclei, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:which(pcs>58  & pcs<65)[1], verbose = FALSE)
nuclei <- FindNeighbors(nuclei, dims = 1:which(pcs>58  & pcs<65)[1], verbose = FALSE)
nuclei <- FindClusters(nuclei, resolution = 0.25, verbose = FALSE)

#For each sample identify the doublets referencing the theoretical doublet formation rate based on cell recovery number
library(DoubletFinder)
sweep.res.list <- paramSweep_v3(nuclei, PCs = 1:10, sct = T)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)
pK=as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK))
BCmetric=bcmvn$BCmetric
pK_choose = pK[which(BCmetric %in% max(BCmetric))]

par(mar=c(5,4,4,8)+1,cex.main=1.2,font.main=2)
plot(x = pK, y = BCmetric, pch = 16,type="b",
col = "blue",lty=1)
abline(v=pK_choose,lwd=2,col='red',lty=2)
title("The BCmvn distributions")
text(pK_choose,max(BCmetric),as.character(pK_choose),pos = 4,col = "red")

annotations <- nuclei@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
nExp_poi <- round(0.075*nrow(nuclei@meta.data))  ## Assuming 7.5% doublet formation rate for the sample 
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi*(1-homotypic.prop))

#NB! if there are two peaks in BCmvn distribution for the neighborhood size parameter pK, then both values were used for filtering, i.e.
nuclei <- doubletFinder_v3(nuclei, PCs = 1:10, pN = 0.25, pK = 0.29, nExp = nExp_poi, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = T) # result specific metadata column "DF.classifications_0.25_0.05_892"
nuclei <- doubletFinder_v3(nuclei, PCs = 1:10, pN = 0.25, pK = 0.05, nExp = nExp_poi, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = T) # result specific metadata column "DF.classifications_0.25_0.29_892"
nuclei@meta.data$DF_score <- ifelse(nuclei@meta.data$DF.classifications_0.25_0.29_892 == "Singlet" & nuclei@meta.data$DF.classifications_0.25_0.05_892 == "Singlet", "Singlet",  "Doublet")
nuclei <- subset(nuclei, DF_score == "Singlet")

#Add sample metadata, e.g.
nuclei@meta.data$orig.ident = "nuclei.wt_1"
nuclei@meta.data$genotype = "wt"
nuclei@meta.data$dataset = "adult"

saveRDS(nuclei, file = "Adult_genetic_singlets_wt_1.RDS")

```
